row.evidence: Rapid7's 'Enable SCIM on the Command Platform' guide documents a SCIM 2.0 endpoint (https://{region}.api.insight.rapid7.com/scim/v2, bearer Platform Admin API key) for IdPs such as Okta, but neither it nor the pricing page (which lists SSO under 'Everything that comes with your plan') names a plan for SCIM.
row.notes: New row. Rapid7 sells products (InsightVM from $1.62/asset/mo for 500 assets, InsightAppSec from $175/mo per app, InsightCloudSec from $5,775/mo for 500 instances) and quote-only packages (Exposure Command, Incident Command, Managed Threat Complete); none is per user, so per-user fields are null. The pricing page says every plan includes unlimited user accounts and single sign-on. SCIM is a Command Platform setting (Administration > SSO Settings) documented without a plan or price, so status is unknown under rule 1a; it may well be included with any product, like SSO. SCIM supports GET/POST/PUT/PATCH on /Users (no DELETE /Users listed) and full CRUD on /Groups; email is the unique identifier. JIT via SAML with a default access profile and rbacGroups group sync. Insight Account REST API (Platform Admin API key) creates, updates, deletes users and manages groups, roles and product access. Audit logs (Platform and SIEM events) can be retrieved through several product APIs.
